name: Ye Kahan Dark Hai Ye Toh Jindagi Hai
visual_description: Comedian Biswa Kalyan Rath holding a microphone and gesturing on Comicstaan with yellow subtitle 'Ye kahan dark hai, ye toh jindagi hai'.
usage_context: Used to react sarcastically to bleak, grim, or dark situations by claiming it is just ordinary life.

example.setup: Friend: Why are your jokes so depressing lately?

text_areas.description: Situation or comment being reacted to
